description: Build a URL that searches Coinbase's x402 Bazaar (Agentic.Market) for a query. Use it when you want x402 services that may be missing from the Agentropolis index; it only returns a link for you or your user to open. Agentropolis makes no request to Coinbase and does not cache or republish Bazaar data (their terms forbid it). Read-only. Example: {"q":"web search"}.

q.description: Search words to prefill on Agentic.Market, e.g. 'image generation'. Omit for the home page.
